2.2 IMPORT THE ELIGIBLE STUDENT LIST AT THE START OF TERM (YC03, YC05)

svg.text: Set how long an Apply / Invite stays open
Save join settings (400 if under 1 hour)
Read rows, map Vietnamese or English headers (email, ho_ten, mssv, du_dieu_kien, ly_do)
Find student by email or student code, create the account if missing
400 No student was imported, with the invalid lines
Flag a student, give a reason
Cancel all their pending Apply / Invite
Remove them from every active group (whatever the lock)
200 eligible, reason (an ineligible student can sign in but gets 403 NOT_ELIGIBLE on formation actions)
